item.title: Etzioni on AI: Where I agree with AI 'doomer' Max Tegmark, and where I think he's wrong
item.description: Former Allen Institute CEO Oren Etzioni debates Max Tegmark on whether AI is already out of control, rogue agents, regulation vs technical fixes, and China's approach — substantive and nuanced, not doom-hype.
